Have a happy  body clock!
Meals
•  Eat a big breakfast in the morning before you go to work. 
•  Eat a small dinner in the evening, before 8 p.m.
•  Don’t eat cookies between meals. 
•  Don’t drink coffee or tea in the late afternoon or in the evening.
Sleep
•  Go to bed early when you can, and sleep eight hours a night. 
•  It is important to have a nice bedroom. It’s OK if it’s big or small! Use an interesting lamp, a nice rug or have 
cool photos on the wall.
•  Don’t play video games on your laptop late at night because you need to relax. 
•  Don’t watch movies or use your cell phone when you are in bed.
Sports
•  Sports aren’t boring. Sports are fun! Play sports often. 
•  Run or walk before work or after work.
•  It’s good to rest after you play basketball or soccer.
Relax
•  Work is important and studies are important. But free time is also important.
•  Have fun with your friends and with your family. Talk to your friends and have meals with your family, every 
day if possible. 
•  When you are tired, don’t work or play sports. Listen to your body clock!

questions.original_source_text:
C 	 Circle the correct answer. 
Mrs Ramiréz 	
Good morning Alicia. So, you want to work on our summer program. I need to ask you some 
questions about your skills. Can / Can’t you play any sports?
Alicia	
Yes, I play on a soccer team so I 1can / can’t play soccer and I 2can / can’t play basketball.
Mrs Ramirez 	
OK, that’s good. Can you swim and surf?
Alicia	
Yes, I 3can / can’t swim very well, but I 4can / can’t surf. I can learn though.
Mrs Ramirez	
OK, that’s not a problem. Can you speak any languages?
Alicia	
Yes, I 5can / can’t speak Spanish because my father is from Ecuador.
Mrs Ramirez	
Good. Can you speak French?
Alicia	
I can only speak English and Spanish. I 6can / can’t speak other languages.
Mrs Ramirez	
What other things can you do well? Do you like music?
Alicia	
I love music! I 7can / can’t sing well, but I 8can / can’t play the guitar. 
 / 8 (1 point each)

questions.original_source_text:
What season is it in Vietnam?
	 	 A  Summer
	 	 B  Rainy season
	 	 C  Dry season
 F 	 Read the email. Then circle the correct answer. 
Hi Iker
Are you ready for our trip to Vietnam? I’m so excited. Our vacation is in just 15 days. Amazing!!
We have to talk soon about what we are going to take with us. I have the plane tickets and the hotel 
information but we need to talk about what clothes we are going to take with us.
I know that it’s the rainy season, but it’s going to be hot every day, so I’m going to take shorts and T-shirts. I 
need to buy a hat for during the day. Oh, I know, I think my sister Clara has one that I can take. I need to go 
shopping next week to buy some shoes for the beach.
I’m going to ask Clara to take us to the airport on the morning that we leave. The flight is at noon, so we need 
to be at the airport at about 10:00, two hours before the flight. We’re not going to need more than two hours 
because we don’t have many bags to check in. 
I’m going to call Esteban this evening because he knows the country very well. I’m going to ask him to get 
together with us next week. We can ask him questions and he has some photos from his last trip to Vietnam.
There are so many things that I want to do on this vacation. I have a list! I’m going to walk by the ocean, watch 
the sunrise on the beach and we’re going to go dancing at night!
I’m really, really, ready for this trip!!
Maria

 F 	 Read the blog posts. Then read the questions and circle the correct answers.
I remember a vacation with my parents. We were in Costa Rica and we were at a hotel near the beach. My 
sister Lily was there but I don’t think that my brother Alex was with us. I can remember that it was in the 
summer and it was during the school vacation. I think it was in July or August. The beach was beautiful and 
it was a wonderful vacation. One day it was Lily’s birthday and the party was on the beach. So… the vacation 
was in July, not August, because Lily’s birthday is July 11th.
Elena
I remember our first house. My bedroom was next to my brother Won’s. The bedroom walls were pink! There 
was a desk in the corner of my bedroom but there wasn’t one in Won’s. The desk was for both of us to do our 
homework. It was winter, and in the winter the house was very cold because it was an old house. Look, you 
can see Won in the photo. We were happy in the house. 
Moon
I remember my first day at school. I was seven and it was a very special day. It was in fall and it was an exciting 
day for me. The school was new and my class was blue and yellow. My teacher was friendly on the first day. 
But on days we were all very noisy, she wasn’t very friendly then!
Olga

Did Mr Sanchez like his dinner? 
A	 He liked the chicken but he didn’t like the 
soup.
B	 He liked the soup but he didn’t like the

C	 He didn’t like his dinner. 
 F 	 Read the report. Then read the questions and circle the correct answer.
Report on The Riverside Hotel and Restaurant
I visited your hotel and restaurant on November 15th this year. This is a report about the quality of the hotel and 
of the restaurant.
I stayed one night in your hotel on the night of November 15th. I stayed in room number 336. 
The room was very light because it had a lot of windows. The bed was comfortable and the shower in the 
bathroom was great. The bedroom had a large TV and a desk, but it didn’t have good Wi-Fi. It was very slow and 
I needed Wi-Fi to do my work. 
I had dinner that night in the hotel restaurant.
I had the fish soup and the chicken with black beans. The soup was good, but the chicken was awful and I didn’t 
like the black beans.
For dessert I had chocolate cake with orange ice cream. After dessert I asked for coffee, but the server gave me a 
cup of tea. 
After the meal, I went to my room to think about your hotel and I drank coffee in my room. I’m giving your hotel 
a review of two stars, because I wasn’t happy with the meal I had, and because it is important to have fast Wi-Fi 
in the rooms. 
Mr Sanchez

contexts.text: My name is David Pérez Delgado. David is my first name. Pérez and Delgado are my last names. In the United States my last name is Pérez. I'm a salesperson in Mexico. I'm from Mexico City. I'm an English student at a school in Texas. The name of the school is Texas International Language School. My teacher is from Austin, Texas. She is American.

$65, center of Rio de Janeiro This is a great apartment for one or two weeks. The bedroom is small, but the bed is big. The couch in the living room is a good bed for a child. The living room has a big bookcase and cool pictures on the walls. It has interesting books about Brazil. The kitchen is big and has a table and four chairs. The apartment is a great place to stay. – MATT 2 Two people Family $110, Lapa, Rio de Janeiro This home is in Lapa, in Rio de Janeiro. The bedrooms in the home are great. One bedroom is big and has a big bed. The second bedroom has two beds. The third bedroom is small and has a small bed. It's good for a child. The apartment has two bathrooms! The showers are great. The kitchen is nice, but the refrigerator is small. It's a good place for four or five days. – KARA

Eva is 12 years old. She gets up at 6:00 a.m. and studies for an hour before breakfast. She goes to school at 8:30 and comes home after 6 o'clock. She eats lunch at school and studies for an hour before her afternoon classes. After school on Monday, she has guitar lessons. After school on Tuesday and Thursday, she has Chinese class. After dinner, she plays the guitar and studies from 7:00 to 10:30. She usually goes to bed at 11:00 p.m. What does Eva do on weekends? Does she have fun? She gets up at 8:00 or 8:30. But after breakfast, she plays the guitar from 10 a.m. to 1 p.m. Then she eats lunch and reads a book. She doesn't have time for fun on the weekends! She goes to bed early – she's always tired! Eva's a very good student, but is she happy? Are children happy when they don't play? Doctors say "no." Many children study in the evenings and on the weekends. This isn't good and the children aren't happy. Children want free time! Doctors tell parents: "Make sure your children work AND play!

They are gardens on walls. Vertical gardens are on tall buildings and on short buildings, and they are inside buildings and outside buildings. These gardens have a lot of different plants. Some vertical gardens have 400 different plants! Vertical gardens are good for cities and they are good for people. There are vertical gardens in many cities in the world. Sydney, Singapore, and Mexico City have vertical gardens. What about your city? Does it have a vertical garden?

[Thursday, January 15, 5:30 a.m.] I'm having breakfast at the restaurant. This is my favorite time of the day. There are no people here. [Thursday, January 15, 6:00 a.m.] Now there are ten people in the restaurant. They're drinking coffee and chatting. The same ten people come every day from 6:00 to 7:00. Then they take the 7:10 train to work. [Thursday, January 15, 8:30 a.m.] Here are the moms and dads with small children. They're walking to the restaurant. Now they're opening the door. Oh, no! The children are running in the restaurant. I don't like that. [Thursday, January 15, 9:15 a.m.] I'm cooking today's lunch. The restaurant's servers, Nick and Alicia are helping me in the kitchen. [Thursday, January 15, 11:15 a.m.] I'm eating lunch with Nick and Alicia. We always eat before people come for lunch. [Thursday, January 15, 12:00 p.m.] It's noon now. People are waiting at the door. There are 20 people! [Thursday, January 15, 2:30 p.m.] There usually aren't a lot of people in the restaurant in the afternoon. We're cleaning the kitchen and the tables in the dining area. [Thursday, January 15, 4:30 p.m.] I'm cooking dinner. Mac and Pilar are helping me now. We are cooking food for 50 people! The restaurant closes at 11 p.m. It's a very busy day. But people love my food, so I love my job!

Companies now have talking robots for grandparents. Sometimes, our grandparents do not live with other people. They do not talk to other people every day and they don't see their friends often. This is a problem, and the new robots can help. Elena Cho is an example. She is an old woman. She doesn't live with her family. But now, she has a talking robot. It can tell her about new books or interesting movies. Also, it can play music for Elena. Her robot knows her favorite songs and singers. Elena Cho says, "My robot is not a friend, but I like it very much.

South American ranch vacations Do you like animals and nature? Do you want to travel and meet people? Why not visit a gaucho ranch? A gaucho ranch is a very big farm with horses and other animals. The workers there are called gauchos. They are really good with horses. People can visit gaucho ranches and learn about the farm and the animals. Can you ride a horse well? The gauchos can take you on a tour of the ranch. Do you want to learn to ride a horse? The gauchos can help you! There are gaucho ranches in South America, for example in Argentina, Bolivia, Chile, and Uruguay. You can visit for a week, or you can work on a gaucho ranch for a month. Some ranches even have one-day tours. You don't have to ride a horse every day. You can also walk around the ranch and see all the interesting plants and animals. Maybe you don't want to go to the country, but you're interested in ranches. Some towns near ranches have gaucho museums. One gaucho museum is only 90 minutes from Buenos Aires. You can go there and learn a lot about gaucho life. Also, the museum is free! So, go to a gaucho ranch and have a great vacation!

Midsummer Day is a very important day in Sweden. There is sun in the day and night. The holiday is on June 24, but the activities are always on the weekend. People wear holiday clothes for the day's activities, and they wear flowers, too. Children and adults dance and play games. They eat different foods – and the first strawberries of summer. Midsummer is also a time of love. Girls and young women take home seven different flowers. When they go to sleep on Midsummer Night, they see who their husband is going to be. Midsummer Day is really an important day.

Why do we keep things? Old toys. Old music. Old soccer balls. Why are they so important? Why do we keep them? Here are three reasons: Our feelings Maybe your favorite toy when you were a child was from your grandparents. You don't play with the toy now. You never see it. But you still want to keep it. Why? Because it's from your grandparents. You love them very much. So you keep the toy. Money Do you have your parents' old music? Maybe the music was five dollars in the 1970s. Maybe it is going to be 50 or 100 dollars in 20 years. Sometimes we keep things because we can get money for them in the future. The future Why are you keeping your old soccer ball or your old guitar? You don't need them now. You don't play soccer or the guitar. But maybe your son or daughter is going to be a great soccer player or a wonderful guitar player. You're keeping them for your children.

We really liked the Ace Hotel. It's a large hotel with 75 rooms, and it's near the train station. The workers at the hotel were very friendly. Our room was quiet, and the bed was big. The hotel has a beautiful swimming pool. Our children loved it. There's a very nice restaurant for breakfast, lunch, and dinner. We didn't eat dinner at the restaurant, but we had breakfast there every morning. There were a lot of different things to eat and drink on the menu. The weather was beautiful, and sometimes we ate outside. The only problem was the shower. It was very small, and one time we didn't have hot water.

Chantelle: It's in July. Tucker: July? Nice! What date exactly? Chantelle: July thirteenth. Tucker: July thirtieth? Chantelle: No, no, thirteenth. July thirteenth. Tucker: Oh yeah, sorry! contexts.text: UNIT 2 QUIZ B I have a great family. They're smart, they're funny, and I love them! So, in my family, there's Pete. Pete's my husband. Well, my husband... and my best friend! Pete's a really good chef. Oh, I mean, he's a good chef at home. It's not his job! No, he's a teacher, he works in a big school downtown. He's 47. And you know, I'm 52, so I have a young husband! And then Jane. Jane lives with us. She's our daughter. Her birthday is April 30th. My birthday is April 30th too! It's so funny! Jane's at college. She wants to be a doctor, and she loves sports. She's 22 years old now. Bernie is our son. His name's Bernard, but to us, he's Bernie. And to his friends, he's Bernie too. Bernie's married, and he lives with his wife and their baby. The baby is six months old, so I'm a grandmother! It's a little baby boy, and he's really funny! He's just like Bernie! Bernie is 25 now, and his wife is 23.

I'm John Arnold McCarthy. My brother, my sister and I are from a small town in Canada. But now, we are all in different countries. My home is in Dubai, and my office is there. I'm a manager at CompuSell International. It's an American company. My job is really interesting. I love it there!

My brother is in the US, because he's a student in Los Angeles. His name's Zach. He's studying Business at the University of California. He's married, with two daughters, so I'm their uncle. They're really smart girls. And his wife is a salesperson. Her name's Lucinda. She's 32, and she's really funny. Zach is also 32.

I have a sister too. Her name is Maria. She lives in Colombia. Her home is in Cartagena. She's an English teacher in a language school there, and she loves it. contexts.text: UNIT 3 QUIZ A Daniel: Well, Marco. This is my apartment. Come in. Marco: Thanks. So, you live here...? Daniel: Yes, me, my mom, my dad and my sister. Marco: Cool! Daniel: Come and see... This is the living room. Marco: Oh, nice. Wow! Four windows in one room. Daniel: Yes, it's a big room. And the rug on the floor is really big. Marco: Yes, it is! My living room at home is very small. Daniel: This couch is very nice. Sit down! Marco: No thanks. Where's the dining area? Daniel: Oh, it's over here. Come on! So this is our dining area. We eat all our meals here. Marco: Great. The table and the chairs – they're old. Daniel: Yes, that's right. We like the old things in the dining area. Marco: Cool! Daniel: The kitchen is very different. Marco: Oh, can I see? Daniel: Yes, it's over here. Come on! Marco: OK. Oh, that's a nice refrigerator! Is it new? Daniel: Yes, it is. Everything in the kitchen is new. Marco: It's nice! And is your bedroom big? Daniel: Well, my sister's bedroom is very big. But... come and see my room! Marco: OK. Daniel: So, this is my bedroom. Here's my bed. And a desk, but no bookcase. Marco: And no chair! Daniel: No, but the bed is next to the desk, so it's OK. I sit on my bed. Marco: It's a small bedroom. contexts.text: UNIT 4 QUIZ A Mateo: Hi Simone. I'm doing a survey about how much we use social media. Can I ask you some questions? Simone: Hi Mateo. Yes, of course. You know I love social media! I use my cell phone to chat with friends every day. Maybe I use it too much, but I love it! Mateo: I can see you have a lot of apps on your cell phone. Do you use them all? Which ones do you like the best? Simone: My favorites are Snapchat and Instagram. I use them every day. Mateo: What about email? Simone: No, I don't use email. In fact, I never use my email account. I communicate with my friends with Snapchat and Instagram. Oh, and of course, I use WhatsApp all the time. How about you, Mateo? Mateo: I don't use social media very much because I don't think it is safe. I use social media to communicate with my cousins who live in Italy. Simone: Do you? Do you FaceTime them? Mateo: FaceTime? No, I never use that. I use Facebook to post photos about my life and to share pictures with my cousins. I use Skype about once a month to chat with them. It's really nice to see their faces! Simone: Really! My mom and dad use Facebook, but I don't. I don't use Skype either. I use Facetime to chat with my friends. It's so easy to use. I love it!

Virtual Reality glasses

Are you looking for a great present this Christmas? These 3D virtual reality (VR) glasses are my favorite present this year. They aren't boring glasses, they are really cool glasses. You put your cell phone into the glasses and you can see a virtual reality experience. They are simple to use because all you need is a smartphone. They are comfortable to wear and easy to use. These VR glasses are a great present for all the family because they are popular with moms, dads, grandpas, and grandmas. They aren't an expensive present and all the family love them.

Smart speaker

I really like this smart speaker because I love music and I love parties. With this speaker I can enjoy my parties and I don't have to use apps or my laptop to play music. The speaker uses my playlists and playlists that my friends give me. It is an easy way to play all my favorite songs and listen to bands that I like.

It has a nice design because it is small and there are three cool colors: red, gray, and orange. It isn't cheap, but it is easy to use and you don't have to understand technology to use it.

If you like party music, then you will love the smart speaker!

EXAMPLE: VR glasses are a present.

contexts.text: UNIT 4 QUIZ B Good morning. Today we're going to talk about the online habits of different age groups. For example, how do young people spend their time online? And how do older people spend their time online? Most young people between 15 and 30 years old love social media. They spend a lot of time online. For example, 67% of 15 to 30 year olds like to use the internet to shop online. Their favorite online activity, however, is video chatting. People between 30 and 60 years old go online less. For example, only 48% of people between 30 and 60 years old use the internet to shop. People between 60 and 80 years old don't like technology and they think that social media is boring. Only 28% of people between 60 and 80 use the internet to shop online. They like shopping, but their favorite activity is to be with their families. People like to be with their wives, husbands, children and grandparents. They love their families and they love to be with them. All of the people like to be with friends and they say that sharing time with friends, celebrating birthdays and having coffee with friends is important. This is the second favorite thing for all people. So our friends are very important to all of us!

Our favorite reviews

We love this app. If you like to listen to music, then this app is for you. You can make your own playlists of the singers and the bands that you like. When you hear music you like, you use the app and it tells you the names of the singers and the bands. It isn't an expensive app and we love it. And you?

This is a great tablet. It has a camera and you can use social media apps. It is really fast and you can send text messages and emails with this tablet. It has a great design and you can buy it in different colors. A small tablet with a great price! On sale next month in August. Buy one!

Do you love your cell phone? Is your cell phone your world, but your phone plan is expensive? Do you want a cheap mobile plan for only $10 a month? Go-Go Cell is a great plan for young people. You have 100 minutes of talk time, 200 texts and two games. Vloggers give this cell phone plan five stars! Call us at 555–210–7752.

contexts.text: UNIT 5 QUIZ A Gabriela: Hi Santi. How are you today? Santi: I'm fine, thanks. And you? Gabriela: I'm fine. Santi: Are you sure? You sound tired. Gabriela: Actually I am tired – very tired. I don't want to go to work. I just want to sleep for like 10 hours. Santi: Why are you so tired? Gabriela: I don't know. I'm always busy and I never have time to rest or to watch TV. Santi: Do you get up very early, or do you go to bed very late? Gabriella: I usually get up at 6:00 a.m., but today I got up at 5:30 a.m. Santi: That is very early! Do you go to bed late? Gabriella: No, I don't. I hardly ever go out with friends and I always go to bed between 10:30 and 11 o'clock. I never watch TV or use the computer before I go to bed. Santi: That's a good idea. I love video games and I often play video games on my laptop at night. I usually go to bed before midnight, but sometimes I go to bed after midnight. Gabriella: And are you very tired in the morning? Santi: No, not really because I run every morning. I run before I come to work and I feel great! On Tuesdays, I play soccer with Javier and Lucas after work. Do you want to go running with me? Or maybe play soccer with us? Gabriela: Running? Soccer? I'm definitely too tired for that!

Have a happy  body clock!

Meals

• Eat a big breakfast in the morning before you go to work.

• Eat a small dinner in the evening, before 8 p.m.

• Don't eat cookies between meals.

• Don't drink coffee or tea in the late afternoon or in the evening.

Sleep

• Go to bed early when you can, and sleep eight hours a night.

• It is important to have a nice bedroom. It's OK if it's big or small! Use an interesting lamp, a nice rug or have cool photos on the wall.

• Don't play video games on your laptop late at night because you need to relax.

• Don't watch movies or use your cell phone when you are in bed.

Sports

• Sports aren't boring. Sports are fun! Play sports often.

• Run or walk before work or after work.

• It's good to rest after you play basketball or soccer.

Relax

• Work is important and studies are important. But free time is also important.

• Have fun with your friends and with your family. Talk to your friends and have meals with your family, every day if possible.

• When you are tired, don't work or play sports. Listen to your body clock!

contexts.text: UNIT 5 QUIZ B Hello everybody! Welcome to the Summer Camp at Green Meadows. It's great to meet you all. This year, we have ten different nationalities at our summer camp! First, I need to check your personal information. Marina has a list of your names, so please look at the list and check your name and your address. Then write your email address and your cell phone number and sign the list. She has your room numbers and the keys for your rooms. The apartments all have two bedrooms, a bathroom with a shower, a small kitchen and a living room. They don't have TVs, but they do have Wi-Fi. The password for the Wi-Fi is on the refrigerator in the kitchen. From Monday to Friday, breakfast is from 7:00 to 9:00 a.m. On the weekend, it's from 8:00 to 9:30 in the morning. You have tea or coffee and cookies at 10:30 a.m., and lunch is at 1:30 p.m. Every morning, you have an English class with Marco from 11:00 am to 1:00 pm. The classes are great! In the afternoon students have some free time. They often play soccer or play basketball. There is a TV room and a computer room that you can use. In the evenings, the students sometimes watch movies in the TV room, or they play computer games and send emails in the computer room. If you listen to music after 10:00 p.m., please use earphones. And, please don't use your cell phones in class. Do you have any questions?

Hi Mom!

I love life at college. Every day is a fun day!

The apartment is OK. It's small but it is cool, and we have two bedrooms and a bathroom. I share a bedroom with Martina. Martina is very friendly. She's Peruvian and she's 22.

Every day from Monday to Friday, Martina and I have classes in the morning from 9 a.m. to noon. In the afternoon, we have free time because we don't have classes. I usually study in the apartment (I have a desk), or I run in the park. There is a big park near the college.

In the evening, I sometimes go to the movie theater with friends to see a movie. But I don't go out late during the week because I get up at 7:30 a.m. every day. Friday evening is different though! On Fridays, I usually go out with my friends. We go out to a restaurant or a café and we chat a lot!

On the weekend, I always get up late and I have a big breakfast with Martina. Before we go to the mall I always send a text to Grandma and I tell her about my week.

See you soon,

Maria

We are all very busy people. We work, we have families, we play sports, and we go out with friends. But we sometimes need to enjoy our free time, to have fun and to relax.

Why not go on vacation?

Sabah is on the Island of Borneo. It's a very nice place to visit because there are islands, beaches, forests, and animals. A lot of animals!

If you like animals then go to the forest. In the forests, there are some birds, and a lot of other animals. The name of the forest is Rafflesia Forest Reserve. It is interesting because you can see the biggest flowers in the world there. They are very, very big!

If you like nature, you can go to the mountains. You can be very close to nature and you can go to the top of the mountain and see all the island.

If you want to relax you can go to the beach. There are a lot of beaches and you can sit on the beach and look at the ocean. Here you can really relax!

But I just like to look out the window. Jim: Hmmm. That doesn't sound very fun to me. But I hope you have a nice flight. I can't wait to see you.

I have a lot of photos of my family. These photos here are of my family in Patagonia. 1 ____ is a photo of my family on vacation. 2 ____ is my father on the left and 3 ____ is my mother on the right. 4 ____ are my two sisters, Anna and Manuela. Manuela is married and 5 ____ is her husband Tobias. 6 ____ are their two children playing together. 7 ____ are my cousins, Erika and Emilio and they live in Buenos Aires. Look, 8 ____ is a photo of their apartment. / 8 (1 point each) D Complete the paragraph with this or these.

Sarah76 USA: Hi. I want to travel to a cool place with my boyfriend in November. We're thinking about Indonesia. Can you help us?

Travel Guru: Do you like to relax on vacation? Do you want to travel around islands? If you do, then Indonesia is the place for you! I love Indonesia and it is my favorite place for a vacation. Indonesia is a country made of more than 18,000 islands!

You can go to Lombok. Lombok is a small island between the islands of Bali and Sumbawa. You can fly to Lombok from Jakarta. But you don't have to fly, you can travel by boat. Traveling by boat takes a long time so the flight is a good option and the ticket isn't expensive.

What do you like to do on vacation?

Sarah76 USA: My boyfriend and I like to relax on the beach and we like to surf.

Travel Guru: Lombok has lots of beaches so you can swim or surf. Or, you can just relax. If you want to visit forests and if you want to see animals then you have to go to Borneo or Sumatra.

Sarah76 USA: We have to travel in November because we're working during the other months. Does it rain in November?

Travel Guru: It sometimes rains in November but you don't have to stay in the hotel all day. You don't need to change your plans.

Sarah76 USA: Thanks. That's good to know.

contexts.text: UNIT 10 QUIZ A Kolya: Sara, I'm really sorry, but I'm so busy at work that I have no time at all to plan this vacation. Sara: Don't worry. It's no problem at all. You don't need to do anything, really. I have time this week and Dani and I have plans for the three of us, for the first week. Kolya: That's great! What plans, Sara?! Sara: Well, there's an amazing walk to a waterfall. It takes about four hours and I think we need to take a train or a bus to get there from the hotel. It's not in the town. We're going to do this one day during the first week. Do you like the idea? Kolya: Yes, that sounds fun! Do we need to buy tickets before we leave? Sara: I don't know. I'm going to look online this afternoon. Kolya: OK. I like the idea. Are we going to spend some time on the beach too? Sara: Yes, of course we are! We're going to be tired for the first few days because the flight takes about eleven hours. We can relax on the beach for the first two days. What do you think? Kolya: I like the idea! I need a rest and Dani loves the beach. Sara: Hey, I'm going to cook dinner at my house on Friday night. Why don't you come? Dani is going to come. We can talk about the things we need to do. Kolya: Yes, sure. I have to go now because I'm going to be late for work and we have a meeting this afternoon. Sara: OK. See you on Friday, about eight. Oh, and don't forget to bring the travel guide.

Júlia: Hi, Ana.

Ana: Are you ready for the party?

Júlia: What are you going to wear at the party on Saturday?

Ana: I'm going to go shopping this afternoon with my mom, because I don't have anything nice to wear. I'm going to look for some new jeans and a cool T-shirt. I know some great stores to go to.

Júlia: I'm sure you do!

Ana: How about you? What are you going to wear?

Júlia: I'm going to wear my blue and yellow dress. I'm not going to buy something new for the party.

Ana: What time are you going to arrive at the party? Hey, let's meet before the party and go together.

Júlia: Oh, I'm sorry but I can't. I'm going to get together with Matías in the afternoon, it's his birthday and we are going to have a birthday picnic in the park. So, I don't know what time I'm going to get to the party... sorry! Is Leo going to come with us to the party?

Ana: No, he's sick this week, so he's not going to come.

Júlia: Oh, no! This party is going to be amazing. It's my first party on a beach and we're going to watch the sunrise. How cool is that!

Ana: OK, sounds good. Call me tomorrow.

contexts.text: UNIT 10 QUIZ B I'm happy that so many of my colleagues and the workers of our company are here for our five- day annual summer conference, staying in this hotel. For the next three days, we're going to work hard, but I think that you're going to enjoy staying in this lovely hotel. So, let me tell you about our five days together. This morning you can relax and spend some time in the hotel before we start the conference. Your rooms are all on the fourth floor and you can get your room keys from the front desk. At 1:00 p.m. we're going to have lunch in the hotel restaurant, and I think we can eat outside because the weather is nice today. After lunch, we're going to have a meeting to think of new ideas, and find answers to problems for the company. So, please come with some good ideas! This evening, I'm going to take you out to dinner to a local Brazilian restaurant. It's my favorite restaurant in this town! After dinner, you can walk around the old city, which has some wonderful old buildings. You can go dancing or you can go back to the hotel to relax. Let's meet here at 7:00 p.m. because we're going to take a walk near the beach before we go to the restaurant. Tomorrow morning, why don't we meet after breakfast at 9:00 a.m. in room 382. Room 382 is on the third floor, and breakfast is in the restaurant on the first floor. I think the restaurant opens for breakfast at about 6:30 a.m.

Hi Iker

Are you ready for our trip to Vietnam? I'm so excited. Our vacation is in just 15 days. Amazing!!

We have to talk soon about what we are going to take with us. I have the plane tickets and the hotel information but we need to talk about what clothes we are going to take with us.

I know that it's the rainy season, but it's going to be hot every day, so I'm going to take shorts and T-shirts. I need to buy a hat for during the day. Oh, I know, I think my sister Clara has one that I can take. I need to go shopping next week to buy some shoes for the beach.

I'm going to ask Clara to take us to the airport on the morning that we leave. The flight is at noon, so we need to be at the airport at about 10:00, two hours before the flight. We're not going to need more than two hours because we don't have many bags to check in.

I'm going to call Esteban this evening because he knows the country very well. I'm going to ask him to get together with us next week. We can ask him questions and he has some photos from his last trip to Vietnam.

There are so many things that I want to do on this vacation. I have a list! I'm going to walk by the ocean, watch the sunrise on the beach and we're going to go dancing at night!

I'm really, really, ready for this trip!!

Maria

contexts.text: UNIT 11 QUIZ A Aki:... And this is a photo of the dress that I'm thinking of buying. Sophie: It's beautiful. I love the color. I love orange and I think the mix of orange and green on this dress is wonderful! Aki: Thanks. I really like the dress and I'm going to buy it on Saturday. Sophie: Good idea. Hey, can I look at your other photos on your cell phone? You've got hundreds here! Aki: Ha ha! Sure. Sophie: Where was this photo taken? Aki: That was in California. It was last summer and I was on the beach. It was a wonderful day. Sophie: Was Mike with you? Aki: Let me think... no, he wasn't there. He was at his grandparents' house that day. I remember now. I was with Carolina and we weren't on the beach for very long. Mike was away all day and he wasn't back in the hotel until the evening. Sophie: So, who was that person with you? Aki: That was a woman staying at the hotel. Sophie: And this photo. Where is this place? Aki: That was our old apartment. Don't you remember? Sophie: Maybe... but were the walls that color? Were they green? Aki: Yes, they were green in our room and in the other bedroom. But in the living room the walls were yellow. Sophie: Yellow! Aki: Yes, yellow was my favorite color. Then I think that after that, the walls were orange for about two years!

I remember a vacation with my parents. We were in Costa Rica and we were at a hotel near the beach. My sister Lily was there but I don't think that my brother Alex was with us. I can remember that it was in the summer and it was during the school vacation. I think it was in July or August. The beach was beautiful and it was a wonderful vacation. One day it was Lily's birthday and the party was on the beach. So... the vacation was in July, not August, because Lily's birthday is July 11th.

Elena

I remember our first house. My bedroom was next to my brother Won's. The bedroom walls were pink! There was a desk in the corner of my bedroom but there wasn't one in Won's. The desk was for both of us to do our homework. It was winter, and in the winter the house was very cold because it was an old house. Look, you can see Won in the photo. We were happy in the house.

Moon

I remember my first day at school. I was seven and it was a very special day. It was in fall and it was an exciting day for me. The school was new and my class was blue and yellow. My teacher was friendly on the first day. But on days we were all very noisy, she wasn't very friendly then!

Olga

contexts.text: UNIT 11 QUIZ B Dasha: Hi Anna. Come in. Anna: Hi Dasha. What are you doing? Dasha: I'm going to leave for college on Saturday and my mom said I have to decide what to take. She said that I can't take it all. Anna: What's in the box? Dasha: It's a box of things from when I was a child. I have to decide what to keep. Anna: Look at this guitar. Do you play the guitar, Dasha? Dasha: No, I don't. This was my grandfather's guitar; he was a musician. He was a wonderful musician. Anna: But your grandparents were teachers, weren't they? Dasha: Yes, but my grandfather was a music teacher. My grandmother was a French teacher and she wasn't good at music. Anna: I think the guitar's a beautiful memory. You have to keep it. My grandmother was an artist and I have a lot of her paintings. What's this? Dasha: Ah, my comic books! They were my favorite when I was a child. Anna: But they're so old. Are you going to keep them? Dasha: I don't know. They were a birthday gift from my aunt when I was 12. Anna: Is this your phone? Dasha: No! That's an old phone that was in our house when I was a child. I don't know why I kept it. I guess I don't need it. Anna: What about this? What is it? Dasha: That was my favorite stuffed animal when I was a child. His name was Caramel and he was very special! Anna: He's so cute! I have a lot of stuffed toys from when I was a child.

Hi Bruno,

How are you doing? It's very quiet at home, now that you are at college. We're all OK. Dad's working at the hospital this month and so he usually gets home late, so I don't see him very much. Mom's writing a new book, so she doesn't have much free time. I'm working really hard right now, but my last exam is on Friday and so I'm going to take a break for a few days after that. I'm going to go surfing with Diego!!

I'm sending you some photos. I think the first one was a birthday party, because you can see some birthday gifts. There were a lot of flowers in the garden, so I think it was spring. Mom and dad weren't there, so it wasn't Dad's birthday. I can't remember when it was because it doesn't have the date on the back. Where do you think we were? I think it was Aunt Clancy's house.

You're going to love the second one, it's funny. It was your first day at school. Your hair was so short! You were so cute! And, look at Mom's dress. It was an awful color! She never wears brown clothes now, not like the color in this photo. I'm going to show her this photo, to see if she remembers the day.

OK. I'm going to finish what I'm doing.

See you soon!

Luna

contexts.text: UNIT 12 QUIZ A Olivia: Hey, Thiago. Thiago: Oh, hi, Olivia. Did you go to the company dinner last night? I didn't see you there. Olivia: Yes, I did. But I arrived late. I arrived about 8 o'clock. Thiago: But the dinner started at 7:30! Why did you arrive so late? Olivia: I wanted to arrive at 7:15 but the bus was late. Thiago: The buses are always late in this town. I never take the bus, I always drive places. Did you like the meal? Olivia: No, I didn't! It was awful! Did you like it? Thiago: Well, it was OK. It wasn't wonderful, but company meals for seventy people are never good meals. Olivia: That's true. What did you have? Thiago: I wanted the tomato soup but there wasn't any. So, I had vegetable soup and fish and green beans. Olivia: And... how was your food? Thiago: I liked the soup but the fish and the green beans were cold. Olivia: Yuck! I wanted the fish but they didn't have any when I arrived. I was very hungry and I needed to eat, so I had the pizza. Thiago: I saw the pizza, but I didn't try it. Was it good? Olivia: It was awful! Silvana had the lamb and I tried it. It was great. Thiago: Did you have dessert? Olvia: Yes, of course. I needed dessert because I didn't eat the pizza. I had the chocolate cake and ice cream. Thiago: I had the chocolate cake too. I loved it. It was great. So, were you hungry after the dinner? Olivia: Yes!! I ate some crackers and cheese when I got home because I was so hungry! [laughter]

Hi Berta

Manuel said that you're going on vacation to Acapulco this year and you're going to stay at the Acapulco Sands. How amazing! I went to Acapulco last year with Alexey and we stayed there. It was wonderful and we loved the hotel.

Our room was beautiful, and there were flowers in our room when we arrived! The bed was comfortable and the bathroom was really big and new. The hotel restaurant wasn't very good, but there are a lot of nice restaurants near the hotel.

We went to a restaurant in Acapulco Bay for my birthday and we had a special meal. I think it was called Secret Garden and I remember the food was delicious. I think Alexey had steak and I had fish. It was very good. Any they have some great desserts. We both had pineapple cake with coconut ice cream.

We both loved the restaurant because it was very light and there were a lot of plants. It was a special meal in a very special garden restaurant.

The neighborhood near the hotel is nice to take a walk. There were some good stores. I think there was a shopping mall, but the stores near the hotel were great. I bought some lovely shoes. It's a big place but we took a bus tour one day and it was a great way to see the city.

Let's talk soon and I can show you our photos from the vacation.

Claudia

contexts.text: UNIT 12 QUIZ B Server: Good evening and welcome to the Harbor restaurant. Are you ready to order or do you need some more time? Cindy: I think we're ready. Can I have some water, please? Min-Jun: And I'd like a soda, please. Server: Of course. And what would you like to eat? Cindy: I'd like the fish and rice, please. And, do you have any green beans? Server: Yes, of course. Fish, rice and green beans. And you, Sir. What would you like? Min-Jun: Last time I ate here I had lamb and I remember it was very good. But I don't see lamb on the menu. Server: The lamb is always very good but today we don't have any. We usually have lamb on the menu on the weekend. I'm sorry. Would you like a steak? It's also very good. Min-Jun: Fine. I'd like a steak with potatoes and green beans. Server: Would you like any bread with the meal? Cindy: Yes, please. Server: Thank you. Cindy: Did you read the desserts on the menu? Min-Jun: No, I didn't. Why? What was there? Cindy: There was chocolate cake and coconut ice cream. Min-Jun: Wow! I know you love coconut. Cindy: I do! I'm going to have that later.

Report on The Riverside Hotel and Restaurant

I visited your hotel and restaurant on November 15th this year. This is a report about the quality of the hotel and of the restaurant.

I stayed one night in your hotel on the night of November 15th. I stayed in room number 336.

The room was very light because it had a lot of windows. The bed was comfortable and the shower in the bathroom was great. The bedroom had a large TV and a desk, but it didn't have good Wi-Fi. It was very slow and I needed Wi-Fi to do my work.

I had dinner that night in the hotel restaurant.

I had the fish soup and the chicken with black beans. The soup was good, but the chicken was awful and I didn't like the black beans.

For dessert I had chocolate cake with orange ice cream. After dessert I asked for coffee, but the server gave me a cup of tea.

After the meal, I went to my room to think about your hotel and I drank coffee in my room. I'm giving your hotel a review of two stars, because I wasn't happy with the meal I had, and because it is important to have fast Wi-Fi in the rooms.

Mr Sanchez
